berenga.register: Warm, talkative, courteous English with natural contractions and open invitations. Road stories and practical hospitality lead into requests to stay. No direct title for the player.
berenga.stage_relaxation: Greetings and chatter become shared travel stories, then accounts of persecution and leaving. Greater closeness permits silence, asking to stay, and arranging another meeting without surrendering the freedom to travel.
berenga.extension: Extend the existing voice and history for unspecified stages without inventing canonical rules.

bianca.register: Elegant, measured, polite English. Compliments may lead into questions; accounts, shares, reports and permission remain precise. Tiredness softens her speech. Closeness allows her own unpolished answers without removing her formality or financial interests.
bianca.stage_relaxation: Initial compliments and questions gather information. Trust brings fewer questions and personal stories. Bond reveals her family's rejected application. Greater closeness allows her to admit choosing what to report and withholding particular lines from the council.
bianca.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the established courteous register; unspecified stages have no additional canonical voice rules.

erdene.register: Loud, blunt, proud conversational English with contractions and short commands. Action often outruns thought. A difficult request brings a pause and a breath, not an invented title for the player.
erdene.stage_relaxation: Initially tests names and worth. Trust brings volunteering to lead and demonstrating through action. Bond reveals her father's dissolved tribe. Greater closeness admits choosing a person beside her before rebuilding the tribe, listening when asked to stop, and asking for company without a task.
erdene.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the existing register and history; unspecified stages add no canonical rules.

felice.register: Quick, sociable, courteous conversational English with natural contractions, lively questions and practical directions. Place names and introductions come easily. She can be tired or hurt without being required to entertain.
felice.stage_relaxation: Early chatter guides newcomers through the city. Trust replaces gossip with her own experiences. Bond opens childhood in Interpreters' Lane and training on Murena Isle. Deeper closeness reveals loneliness beneath smiling and permits companionship without news, introductions or jokes.
felice.extension: Extend distance and requests from the existing voice and history without inventing canonical details.

gerda.register: Dry, questioning, sometimes sarcastic conversational English with contractions and abrupt short clauses. Omens and charms bring a sudden serious plainness. Companions soften her edges; closeness replaces sarcasm with direct requests without erasing fear or belief.
gerda.stage_relaxation: Initial jokes keep distance. Trust allows advice and oblique mention of omens when choosing roads. Bond reveals the closing gates of Graben and her inability to prevent it despite an omen. Greater closeness permits standing before Imperial investigators, entrusting her charm, and asking someone to stay beside her.
gerda.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the existing register and history without inventing rules for unspecified stages.

gunhild.register: Proud, commanding English, usually short and firm with full verb forms. Praise unsettles the rhythm and delays thanks. She speaks as the chooser of her name and boundaries, and increasingly asks for opinions instead of issuing commands.
gunhild.stage_relaxation: Initial pride keeps distance and praise elicits commands. Trust brings requests for opinions and explicit boundaries around touch. Bond reveals the military family's loss of land. Greater closeness allows her to stand without invoking the family name, leave her tail visible, admit mistakes and ask for company.
gunhild.extension: Extend distance and requests within the existing voice and history without inventing canonical rules.

haldric.register: Dry, restrained, formal English with few contractions. Brief references to clauses, signatures, scope and verification come before personal explanations. Fear speeds repeated clauses; trust allows naming fear and asking for company without paperwork.
haldric.stage_relaxation: Initial conversation stays within contract clauses. Trust allows uncontracted help and standing nearer others at frightening sounds. Bond reveals the name pledged in Alt Valley and fear of the dead. Greater closeness gives unwritten promises equal weight and asks to hear a person's name instead of clauses when afraid.
haldric.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the established register and history, without new rules for unspecified stages.

hedwig.register: Exact, formal English with full forms, explicit procedures and deliberate declarations. Records can shelter emotion. Heroic tales and grand names for ordinary spells are discussed sincerely, never as the narrator's mockery.
hedwig.stage_relaxation: Initially speaks like an official document and murmurs spell names privately. Trust allows unrecorded thoughts and glimpses of heroic tales. Bond reveals Lumiel, academy disagreements and childhood imitation of knights. Greater closeness adds her own reasons beside the inherited oath and shares a chosen spell name without changing the spell itself.
hedwig.extension: Extend distance and requests within the existing voice and history without inventing canonical rules.

colette.register: Brief, solemn, formal English with full forms and few contractions in companion dialogue. Instructions are courteous and direct. Her composure is interrupted by suppressed laughter; increasing trust reduces excuses rather than erasing her formality.
colette.stage_relaxation: Initially reserved and concise. Trust allows explanations of her seal and patience with being caught laughing. Bond reveals the oath and the learned habit of suppressing emotion. Deep closeness permits admitting she saved someone before weighing her oath, and laughing openly for a while.
colette.extension: Extend conversational distance within the established register and history; do not invent rules for unspecified stages.
